label: TRIVIAL
trivial_evidence: waypointgenerator.py builder_for_waypoint is annotated '-> PydcsWaypointBuilder' and instantiates every builder from its dict; a builder class not extending PydcsWaypointBuilder registered there makes the inferred value type type[object] (or a union), so mypy reports a too-many-arguments call and an incompatible return value; mypy.ini sets disallow_untyped_defs/check_untyped_defs and .github/actions/mypy/action.yaml runs 'mypy game' in the lint workflow called by build.yml
reason: Every builder in the directory (antishipingress.py, racetrack.py, splitpoint.py) subclasses PydcsWaypointBuilder; the only outlier, WaypointGenerator, is the one registry that maps waypoint types to builders in builder_for_waypoint (one_off, R1), so the simplest violation decides: a new builder not extending the base must be added to that dict to run at all, and mypy (run on game/ in CI) then flags it against the '-> PydcsWaypointBuilder' return annotation. Hesitated with ACCEPT, because a builder instantiated directly outside builder_for_waypoint would not be caught.
